recipe.visualDefinition: A central portrait contained within a light blue rounded-rectangle window, framed by a textured red leather surface with visible perimeter stitching. The subject is a man in a suit holding a revolver and a vertical strip of identification cards.
coreVisualRelationships: The red leather frame acts as a physical 'wallet' container for the central image.
The light blue background of the inner frame provides high contrast against the dark suit and red border.
The vertical ID strip creates a secondary visual rhythm within the central composition.
The gun barrel points directly at the viewer, creating a forced perspective depth.
coreInvariants: Double-stitched border on the red leather frame
Rounded corners on the inner blue window
Hard drop shadow behind the subject against the blue background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered, occupying the middle 70% of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized title text at the top center of the inner window.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top title, down to the subject's face, following the gun barrel to the bottom, then back up the ID strip.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The red leather border provides significant negative space, focusing attention on the inner 'photo'.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red border; medium saturation with high value in the blue window; low value in the subject's suit.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif with interlocking or overlapping characters.
letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight kerning with character overlaps
Slightly flared or curved baselines on specific letters
White fill with a thin dark outline
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'F' has an elongated top bar
The 'l' and 'e' are tucked into the 'F'
The 'h' has a descender-like curve that underlines the preceding letter

composition.position: Top center of the inner window
composition.overlap: Overlaps the top of the subject's head

composition.position: Bottom center of the inner window

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy custom display face paired with a clean, functional condensed sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky feel for the display text.
Matches the utilitarian feel of the secondary metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A red leather wallet texture with visible stitching around a central rounded-rectangle cutout. Inside the cutout is a man in a black suit against a light blue background, holding a gun and a strip of ID cards.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, bold, white interlocking display title at the top center and a smaller condensed sans-serif subtitle at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the leather texture visible and realistic?
Does the title text overlap its characters?
Is the inner frame's corner radius consistent?

adjustableVariables: Leather color (e.g., brown instead of red)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the stitching follows the perimeter of the red frame.
Check that the title text is legible despite the tight kerning.
Verify the drop shadow behind the subject is consistent with the lighting.
Confirm the ID strip looks like a physical insert.
recipe.reuseFormula: Red leather frame + Rounded blue window + Centered portrait + Heavy interlocking white display type.
